analogy.rationale: CPT1A inhibition blocks mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation, a metabolic pathway whose transcriptional footprint in these cell lines is modest and largely limited to lipid/energy metabolism genes. Drugs targeting other lipid metabolic enzymes (FASN, HMGCR) or lipid-sensing nuclear receptors (PPAR) may partially overlap, but no class should produce a strong shared transcriptional response.
